mapper.insert: insert into employee(emp_no, branch_code, dept, grade_code, position_code, name, phone, email, hire_date, status) values(#{empNo},#{branchCode},#{dept},#{gradeCode},#{positionCode},#{name},#{phone},#{email},#{hireDate},#{status})
mapper.select: select emp_no as empNo, branch_code as branchCode, dept, grade_code as gradeCode, position_code as positionCode, name, phone, email, hire_date as hireDate, status from employee where emp_no=#{value}
select count(emp_no) as totalEmp from employee
select count(distinct branch_code) as totalBranch from employee
select count(emp_no) as newEmp from employee WHERE hire_date BETWEEN CONCAT(YEAR(CURDATE()), '-01-01') AND CURDATE()

select e.emp_no as empNo, e.branch_code as branchCode, b.name as branchName, e.dept, e.grade_code as gradeCode, e.position_code as positionCode, e.name, e.phone, e.email, e.hire_date as hireDate, e.status, p.position_name as positionName, g.grade_name as gradeName from employee e left join branch b on e.branch_code = b.branch_code left join position p on e.position_code = p.position_code left join grade g on e.grade_code = g.grade_code
and e.emp_no like CONCAT('%', #{empNo}, '%')
and e.dept like CONCAT('%', #{dept}, '%')
and p.position_name like CONCAT('%', #{positionName}, '%')
and g.grade_name like CONCAT('%', #{gradeName}, '%')
and e.name like CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET branch_code = #{branchCode}, dept = #{dept}, grade_code = #{gradeCode}, position_code = #{positionCode}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, status = #{status} WHERE emp_no = #{empNo}
